summary: Recomputed every numeric claim in the historical ledger using an exact paired-rescoring identity, classified all 203 score-and-move pairs into their scoring mode, found a permanently unsatisfiable frozen protocol gate, identified two preregistered rejections that reverse sign under corrected scoring, and produced the seed-range import table the benchmark contract requires.
validationPerformed: Classified all 203 (score, moves) pairs; corroborated independently against 26 sources carrying 7,000-point build assertions.
Calibrated the rescoring constant against a replay whose move counts are byte-identical across scoring modes.
limitations: Recorded by the coordinator on the delegated agent's behalf; the agent had no write access to research/ and did not review this transcription.
Read-only audit; recomputation from documented figures, not a rerun of the original experiments.
